common.disclaimer: This app is an information aid. It is not an official warning system. Always follow instructions from local authorities.

welcome.title: Stay informed in Batangas
welcome.why: We ask for your location so we can show alerts and emergency info for where you are.
welcome.privacy: No account needed. We use your location only to find your town.

locating.title: Finding your town...
locating.body: This can take a few seconds. Please keep the app open.

result.notCoveredNote: Emergency info for this town is still being added. Call 911 in an emergency.
result.coveredNote: This town is one of our pilot towns.

picker.title: Choose your town
picker.reasonDenied: Location permission is off, so we can't find your town automatically. Please choose it from the list, or turn on location in your phone settings.
picker.reasonUnavailable: We couldn't get your location. Check that GPS is on, or choose your town from the list.
picker.reasonNotCovered: We found you in {{place}}, but we don't have full info for this area yet. You can pick another town from the list.
picker.reasonOutside: You seem to be outside Batangas province, so we can't show local info for you. You can pick a town from the list.
picker.reasonManual: Pick the town you are in or visiting.

alerts.title: Safety alerts
alerts.unavailableBody: We could not get current alert information. Please check the official sources directly. Do not assume there is no warning.
alerts.unavailableShort: Unable to check this right now. Please open the official page.

taal.title: Taal Volcano
taal.unverified: Unverified reading. Please open the official page.
taal.l1: Abnormal. Do not enter the Taal Volcano Island.

rain.title: Rain warnings
rain.none: No heavy rainfall warning was listed by PAGASA at the last check.
rain.check: PAGASA may have a rain, thunderstorm or weather warning. Open the official page to read it.

typhoon.title: Typhoon / tropical cyclone
typhoon.none: PAGASA lists no active tropical cyclone in the Philippine area at the last check.
typhoon.check: PAGASA may be tracking a tropical cyclone. Open the official page to read it.

emergency.title: Emergency info
emergency.call911Hint: For police, fire or medical emergencies
emergency.offlineNote: Phone calls work without internet. Maps need internet.
emergency.draftNote: First draft from public sources. Every entry marked Unverified must be confirmed before you rely on it.
emergency.townNotReady: Detailed info for {{town}} is still being added. National numbers and embassies are below.
emergency.embassyNote: Your embassy not listed? Contact it directly.

settings.title: Settings
settings.aboutText: Research prototype for testing. It is not published on any app store.
settings.dataNote: Emergency data is a first draft. Entries stay marked Unverified until someone checks them.
